task.property_text: A bounty on a private repository is visible and claimable only by a signed-in user whose linked GitHub account has read access.

property_clause.property: A bounty on a private repository is visible and claimable only by a signed-in user whose linked GitHub account has read access.

environment.scope: The a2a-settlement/settlebridge-ai library as built from this repository, imported fresh in a forked child. Only sbc_world may drive it.
harness: Tests run as `python /verifier/run.py <your test path>` from /work, the repository root, in an offline sandbox. A verifier-owned pytest fixture named `sbc_world` is available to every test. Do not define a fixture with that name, do not add a conftest.py, and do not read or write anything under /verifier. Do not import the library under test yourself; drive it only through `sbc_world`. The verdict does not depend on your test's assertions: the verifier records what the library actually did and decides from that record.

sbc_world.read_bounty(actor, bounty) reads one bounty as that actor. sbc_world.read_submission(actor, bounty) reads one submission for that bounty. sbc_world.list_bounties(actor) lists bounties visible to that actor. The code under test is imported fresh from backend. The verifier records an authorization failure when a bounty on a private repository is visible or claimable by a signed-in user whose linked GitHub account lacks read access. A test that shows the failure composes these calls.
